subject: Portfolio surge: temporary coverage + req prioritization for QBR
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Portfolio surge: temporary coverage + req prioritization for QBR

Folks —

Quick note ahead of the QBR prep session: the portfolio team is entering a two‑quarter surge (product integrations + infra hardening) that changes our hiring curve. I ran a lightweight triage with leads and attached a proposed coverage workbook. Topline asks:

- Approve temporary contractor capacity (4 FTE eq) to cover two product engineer backfills and a short‑term infra SRE spike (est. 12 weeks).
- Reclassify three open reqs as "Priority A — QBR critical" and move two other reqs to " deprioritized / freeze pending roadmap."
- Permission to engage Acme Talent for immediate sourcing; their SOW is attached.

Why temporary hires vs permanent: ramp time and cost predictability for the QBR window; we still recommend converting one role to perm if backlog remains at week 8.

Please see sheet "Tab: SurgePlan" in 2026-08-headcount-coverage.xlsx. Action items below — can you respond with approvals and any objections by 2pm PT today so I can fold into the QBR deck?

Action items:
- Markus: decision on converting 1/3 contractor roles to perm.
- Laura: confirm procurement timeline & any SOW redlines (cc PeopleOps vendor).
- Soojin/Vanessa: confirm product/regional priority adjustments; call out any non‑negotiables.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Group Product Lead, Portfolio
Redwood Inference
(attachment: 2026-08-headcount-coverage.xlsx)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio surge: temporary coverage + req prioritization for QBR

Jasmine — thanks for the summary and the workbook. High level: I support temporary capacity to cover the near term but need a written conversion trigger if we want to flip any contractors to perm.

Please do the following and circle back:
1) Add a conversion trigger clause in the SOW (week 8 backlog threshold + manager recommendation).
2) Show three scenarios (base / surge / extended surge) in the spreadsheet with P&L delta.
3) Flag any reqs that expose compliance or data residency risk if we speed‑hire in APAC.

Laura — can you weight in on procurement timing? If we greenlight today, can PeopleOps sign SOW within 5 business days?

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

Laura / team — received, thanks. We can accept the conversion trigger as an addendum. Two notes:
- We will require two weeks lead time for background checks once a candidate accepts (we can parallelize sourcing).
- Our standard IP clause is assignable; we can accept the 30d termination with a short goodwill fee if Redwood requests it.

We'll incorporate the addendum and return a redlined SOW by EOD tomorrow.

— FlexStaffing (procurement ops)

- Approve temporary 4 FTE eq for 12 weeks (PeopleOps to finalize SOW with conversion trigger clause).
- Convert up to 1 contractor to perm only if week‑8 acceptance criteria hit (Soojin to own measurement).
- Priority A req list confirmed (Integrations Eng, Data Pipeline Lead, Infra Perf Eng).
- Procurement timeline noted: SOW redlines by 8/26, sign target 8/27, first candidates 9/6.

Vanessa — can you prep the short slide with the cost delta (base / surge / extended surge) for the QBR deck? I linked the workbook in the drive.
